recommended_task.rationale_for_single_coordinated_task: All 5 proposals rebase test/doc assertions onto the SAME underlying live-inventory fact (20 tools, 16/4 tier split). Splitting them into 5 separate patch tasks risks each worker deriving the count independently and landing mutually inconsistent numbers -- which already happened once inside B251 itself (STALE_3's 14-vs-16 arithmetic slip, corrected by this plan). A single task with one source-of-truth derivation step, applied atomically across all 8 target files, eliminates that failure mode.
